notes.title: Forest Ranger Patch 1.6
notes.content:
Hello Rangers!
Due to the bugs you reported, we have decided to update the current version of the game, which fixes some of the bugs you reported. You can find the list of fixed things below! In addition, the reported bugs we will try to fix also welcome reports, including those related to changes in gameplay.

[previewyoutube=NlfBGVcu9y0;full][/previewyoutube]


[Fixed]
[list]
[*] Bug reporter restored (IMPORTANT: If there is a problem with the record please attach the last record and log file)
[*] Corrected display of German and French in ForestWiki
[*] Fixed bug with entering the pop-up menu near the computer
[*] There is no longer an effect on the screen after the hunger bar drops.
[*] Added audio effects after hunger bar drop.
[*] Added notifications after hunger bar drop and thirst bar drop.
[*] Rebalanced and reduced hunger and thirst consumption.
[*] Visual changes to the timer for the start of the tourist season.
[*] Fixed bug with timer stopping when entering the store.
[/list]


In the near future, an update will be added to improve performance and allow gameplay with a gamepad. 

Hope to hear from you soon!

notes.title: Major Update - Rebuild your Home
notes.content:
[h1]Here is a long-awaited big update for the Forest Ranger Simulator.[/h1]

[h2][u]What was changed and improved:[/u][/h2]

[h3][b]Main Quests:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Main Quests available in Sandbox and QuestMode. 
[*] Discover the Mystery of the Forest and rebuild the destroyed forester's house. 
[*] New Main Quests revealing the secrets of the forest will be added with each update
[*] In the pop-up menu under the Tasks tab, the Main Quests category has been added. 
[*] In the pop-up menu under the Tasks tab, Main Quests have their own walkthrough description and the information needed to complete them
[*] With each Main Quest started, a notification will appear with information about the quest
[*] When a Main Quest is completed, a notification appears with the quest reward.
[*] Elements translated into all languages available in the game
[/list]

[h3][b]Rebuilding the forester's house:[/b][/h3] 
[list]
[*] Rebuild the house and the destroyed components. Components have the destroyed component highlighted. 
[*] Information on components for rebuilding. 
[*] Adding items have their own animation.
[*] Progress icon when rebuilding with a hammer.
[*] Change of highlighting if the component is ready to be rebuilt with the hammer.
[*] Components need a new plank resource for rebuilding 
[/list]

[h3][b]New plank resource:[/b][/h3] 
[list]
[*] Picking up new plank items for the inventory
[*] Possibility to catch and throw planks
[*] A resource needed to complete the rebuilding of a house
[/list]

[h3][b]Table for crafting planks:[/b][/h3] 
[list]
[*] A place to set aside logs for plank making
[*] Interactive plank-making table 
[*] Interactive log saw 
[*] Log cutting progress bar
[*] Place of emergence of boards marked with an icon
[*] Elements translated into all available languages in the game
[/list]

[h3][b]Bed:[/b][/h3] 
[list]
[*] The ability to sleep comes after the house reconstruction is completed
[*] Time can be brought forward to 8h - this is how much the Forest Ranger is able to sleep
[*] Icon when switching to the sleep function
[*] Panel for selecting sleeping time
[*] Visual effect of the transition to sleep

notes.title: Mechanic of Crafting
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Rangers![/h3]

Today is the National day of the Forester and the Timberman! It's common in our country - Poland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/52af4c1feab607ec5b52f2ff03edd691e8409654.png[/img]

It's a celebration of people who, care about sustainable management of forest areas in Poland. On this day it is worth thinking about the importance of forests not only for wildlife but also for humans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/c64316db38ebc410408ef38e04e06f5aaae30f0e.jpg[/img]

This is a perfect time to explore a new skill! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/11da1d94aa4e544ae114e80bfac2430e6d97eb8b.jpg[/img]

Are you tired of waiting for the courier? Not sure when it will arrive? It's time to take matters into your own hands! Nothing prevents you from crafting your own items! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/ed5bfce09cbe5ff0a1aeec88b8ef8f828c02969d.jpg[/img]

Collect sticks! Cut down withered trees! And produce for your own items! See you on the trail!
PS: Don't forget to buy nails!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/f85cc64066dbaffbc31e6322b210a64420e79268.jpg[/img]


All the best 
from the Forest Ranger Simulator team

tags.feature: This is a perfect time to explore a new skill!
Nothing prevents you from crafting your own items!

notes.title: New mechanics
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Rangers! [/h3]

[u]We are halfway through [b]Kickstarter[/b]. More than [b]200 backers and YouTubers[/b] sent us a lot of feedback and ideas.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/0f9e45d9a9f3ffe7e734b8faf902f8a590921500.png[/img]

Firstly, if you still haven't played our demo, maybe check how funny it can be by the[b] reactions of Youtubers[/b] playing it.
[previewyoutube=Y4C1ICFrLEg;full][/previewyoutube]


Secondly, [b]a new mechanic in the game - tree cutting[/b]. Yes, Forest Ranger also cuts down trees. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TvNiIwQ.gif[/img]


Why? Maybe for building something? Nope, it's because those trees are infected and are dying. Woodworms are the real plague of the forests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/e0168e091067c24ddc2dd2a34f6c641bc2489ba6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/c577eba069d512c0f5bfd5f8a3429ca1aa43babd.jpg[/img]


Remember, if you make a mistake and chop the wrong tree (a healthy one) you will get a penalty!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/9f027085ba12c0cee9e61539b4348ac56785c283.jpg[/img]


Thirdly [b]changes and improvements in the game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/8a955a9c9adfa6afdcd17c3ba78dd1be1785475a.jpg[/img]

We have removed the purchase of containers in the online store and now you can buy them on the spot in the field or under your house at designated locations. We have also added a description of what type of container we can buy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/e97473a6d510b4f515edf0597c1f6c21b4043192.jpg[/img]


Lastly, [b]Two new pledges are coming to our Kickstarter where you can get some great prizes.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/38ad40adc37da848cc9e27faca0c6d7e37ebff4d.png[/img]

If you want to check it out here is the link ➡️ [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/freemindgames/forest-ranger-simulator-game-about-saving-the-nature]FOREST_RANGER_SIMULATOR_KICKSTARTER[/url][/b]

Hail to the rangers!
Forest Ranger Simulator team

notes.title: Statistics
notes.content:
[h3]Hey nature lovers![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/df7f97136cefac41c3fe9acf5e1723da66d21fdc.jpg[/img]

[b]We've added a new feature to our game! [/b]

It is good to know how much work has been done so we have created a brand new tab - [b]STATISTICS[/b].

Here you will be able to check the progress of your work in caring for the forest in real time. It will also be easy to see how your finances are doing and which activities are bringing the best return for your park.
